name: H3 multi-probe Block Cache (T8)
plain: A MiniMax H3 cache that measures change after several probe blocks and compares global, audio and video indicators, with separate tails for audio and video. It stops the model through an exception once it decides to hit. Only the global score gates, in the code read.
math:
I_x = sampled(x_after_probe) − sampled(x_before), for whole, audio and video slices at metric_stride.
score = mean|I−I_prev|/max(mean|I_prev|,1e-6) over finite entries; ∞ if non-finite positions changed.
Hit if eligible σ, comparable, global_score < τ, hits<max.

props.hook: add_wrapper / block patches, H3BlockCacheHit exception (not traced to the node wiring)
